items.title: GTA 5 Launched on PS3. GTA 6 Is for PS5 🎮
items.description:
GTA 5 launched on PlayStation 3 in 2013. GTA 6 comes out November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

The longest gap between GTA games before this was about 5.4 years (GTA IV, April 29, 2008, to GTA 5, September 17, 2013). GTA 5 to GTA 6 is more than double that.

The date moved twice:
- First target: fall 2025 (Take-Two, February 2025)
- Delay 1: announced May 2, 2025, new date May 26, 2026
- Delay 2: announced November 6, 2025, new date November 19, 2026

Sources: rockstargames.com/VI and the launch trailer's end card (October 15, 2026), Rockstar's statements as reported by VGC (May 2, 2025) and Variety (November 7, 2025), rockstarnorth.com for the GTA 5 date. The year counts are our own arithmetic from those release dates.

Made with our own graphics. No Rockstar footage. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

items.title: Which Game Outsold GTA 5? 🤔
items.description:
GTA 5 has sold nearly 235 million copies, Take-Two's own count from November 2026 (units sold-in). Not Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (72 million) and not Wii Sports (82.9 million).

Tetris claims over 520 million, but that number adds up every Tetris game since 1984. Counted as one single game, the best-seller is Minecraft: Xbox's CEO says over 425 million copies, over 190 million more than GTA 5. Each company counts its own way.

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Can it ever catch Minecraft?

Sources:
- Take-Two Investor Presentation, November 2026 (GTA V nearly 235 million units sold): https://ir.take2games.com/static-files/c4c4f7f0-6a7c-4159-b97f-089a76580c38
- Take-Two 10-Q, quarter ended Sept 30, 2026 (GTA V sold-in over 230 million): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/946581/000162828026072254/ttwo-20260930.htm
- Take-Two Q2 FY2027 results, Nov 9, 2026 (GTA VI on November 19, 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/946581/000162828026072175/ttwo2q27earningsrelease.htm
- VGChartz, Minecraft sales top 425 million (Xbox CEO, Sept 26, 2026): https://www.vgchartz.com/article/469182/minecraft-sales-top-425-million-units/
- Guinness World Records, best-selling videogame (Minecraft): https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/best-selling-video-game
- The Tetris Company (over 520 million units): https://tetris.com/news/the-tetris-company-celebrates-a-landmark-year-of-global-growth-in-2025
- Nintendo IR, Wii Sports and Mario Kart 8 Deluxe sales: https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/software/wii.html and https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/software/switch.html
- Rockstar Games, GTA VI release date: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI

The 190 million gap is our own arithmetic from those figures.

Made with our own graphics. No Rockstar footage. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
